Paid-tier, Basic-authenticated synchronous service. SiVa backs PAdES/ASiC-E and can return
`passed`/`failed`. ADOC runs Tvarka's internal STRUCTURAL inspector, which performs no
cryptographic verification and therefore never returns `passed` - a structurally sound ADOC
yields `status: structural`. The verdict is advisory, not a regulatory conclusion. A
successful service call emits exactly one `atk.validate` event. `Idempotency-Key` makes network
